issues: 输入框是 4px 白色实线框 + Helvetica，像线框稿；morph 时白框里填半透明白，中途是一块脏灰色胶囊
四粒图元是平涂暖白色块，只有一圈均匀白晕，没有受光和落影，贴在背景上
图元下落是纯平移 spring，没有速度带来的形变或拖影，落地没有重量
背景是死平的 #3d1f47；单瓣落定后整组偏左上（外接框中心约 925,452）
呼吸在 f108 以满振幅直接起跳；工作台按 130f 截断，md 写明的 140f 后 10f 没渲出来
changes: 输入框改为暗色磨砂玻璃：1.5px 发丝亮边 + 顶部内高光 + 带色相落影，文字系统字体、飞走时加模糊，发送键是受光的暖白按钮；morph 时不透明的玻璃色盖在暖白材质上按进度揭开，不再经过半透明灰
图元换成有体积的暖白材质（顶亮底暗渐变 + 顶部内高光 + 底部内阴影 + 梅紫色相落影），金色小圆同法处理
下落按 spring 每帧速度做 squash & stretch：下落中纵向拉长 ≤12%、回弹时压扁，原点钉底部，并按速度给轻微纵向拖影
背景加纵向渐变 + 中心粉紫柔光 + 暗角 + 颗粒；单瓣整组右移 35、下移 50px，外接框中心回到画面中心略偏上
呼吸振幅 0→0.03 在 20f 内 in-out 渐入；补导出 INPUT_MORPHS_INTO_LOGO_DURATION=140（按 md 时长），时间轴与 spring 参数全部保持原值
issuesEn: The input was a 4px solid white outline in Helvetica, like a wireframe, and the morph filled it with translucent white, passing through a dirty grey capsule
The four pieces were flat warm-white blocks with only a uniform white glow, no light or cast shadow, stuck to the background
The drops were pure translation springs with no speed-driven deformation or blur, so landings had no weight
The background was flat #3d1f47, and the settled mark sat up and to the left (bounding-box centre around 925,452)
Breathing started at full amplitude on f108, and the workbench cut at 130f, dropping the last 10f of the 140f the md specifies
changesEn: The input is now dark frosted glass: 1.5px light hairline, top inner highlight, tinted cast shadow, system-font text that blurs as it flies off, and a lit warm-white send button; during the morph an opaque glass layer over the warm-white material peels away with progress, never passing through translucent grey
Pieces use a warm-white material with volume (top-lit gradient, inner top highlight, inner bottom shade, plum-tinted cast shadow); the gold dot gets the same treatment
Drops get squash & stretch from per-frame spring velocity: up to 12% vertical stretch while falling and a squash on rebound, origin pinned to the bottom, plus slight vertical speed blur
Background gains a vertical gradient, soft pink-violet centre glow, vignette and grain; the whole mark moves 35px right and 50px down so its bounding box sits just above frame centre
Breathing amplitude eases in 0→0.03 over 20f; added INPUT_MORPHS_INTO_LOGO_DURATION=140 per the md, with all timings and spring values unchanged
